posts.name: Kera
posts.cooked:
Hi

Does anyone know how one could achieve differing edit/ view access dependent on company field, without the use of a server script, configurable via the UI’s roles and/ or permissions.

For example:
We have companies A and B.
I belong to company A.
I need to be able to view and edit data for all those also assigned to company A, for a particular docType.
However, for company B, I still need to be able to view the data, but not be able to edit it.

The same would then work for company B, where the manager would be able to view and edit for those in company B, however still be able to only view those assigned to Company A.

Would greatly appreciate suggestions.
Thanks.

posts.name: Sudhanshu Badole
posts.cooked:
Set User Permission .
where user will only be able to view the records of company A if you set User permission
allow: company
for value : Company A

https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/basics/users-and-permissions
